behavior: Missing model files open the initial dialog without user interaction.
A full cache is detected using every current model asset hash and URL, without downloading weights.

Selecting another recipe can start it directly while the current recipe is cooking.
Explicit reset and pause remain paused.
Missing or blocked cache shows the loader; initialization failures can be retried.
